svg.title: Why the null still says something, a lesson in counting, and robustness checks that all stayed null.

section.div: Why this null still says something
section.p: The intervals are narrow. A one standard deviation rise in how aroused you feel is unlikely to lower your posterior alpha by more than about 0.05 standard deviations.
For valence, effects larger than about 0.11 SD in either direction are unlikely. If these links exist at the level of whole songs, they are small.

div.span: Pool every trial as if independent
One slope per person, then combine

section.p: Treating trials as people (pseudoreplication) claims precision the data do not have. Mixed models with listeners as the unit fixed that.

section.h2: It held every way it was poked

div.span: Leaving out each listener in turn (×20)

section.p: H1 slope stayed between 0.03 and 0.06, every p above .25.
